clean.tx: Par bétg tg' in schleschi dat il calger eign in pêr guspas els calzers.
clean.tl: In order not to slip, the shoemaker hits some nails into the shoes.

clean.tx: ˈʥeːvjǝ zɛ l ˈtɔni dɐ lɐ mɐtˈlajnɐ sǝʃfǝrdɐnˈtaws ʃi feʨ dɐ ˈbajbǝr trajs ˈmjɔːlas pɛn frajt
clean.tl: On Thursday Matlaina’s Toni caught a very strong cold because he drank three cups of cold buttermilk.

clean.tx: A Cazis èr’ ju ajn tgòmbra, alṣò qu’ èra tgòmbras da trajs, a lu qu’ è adina, ina è gè adina pr̩sula, a nus trajs vèvan ábar … súpar!
clean.tl: In Cazas I was in a room, well these were rooms for three, and then this was always, one is always alone, of course, but the three of us, we had … a great time.
